_metadata.title: Cluevoyance Unlimited - 20-word pair-clue pilot
_metadata.clue_text_rule: One uppercase word, or a familiar two-word phrase, up to 18 characters including the space. The game does not enforce a length in code (EditableClueTab only trims and uppercases). A clue may never be one of the twenty pilot words: a board word used as a clue is unplayable.
_metadata.quality_note: Every clue here survived the hand audit recorded in pilot-clue-quality-audit.json. That audit is editorial judgement, not something the validator can prove; validate-pilot.mjs checks structure only.
